basis: Alport nephropathy, deafness and esophageal leiomyomatosis define syndrome; cataract in 3/4 supports ocular involvement. Airway leiomyomatosis occurs in <30%.
Progressive cerebellar neurodegeneration; retinal and optic nerve degeneration are subtype-specific, not common across the umbrella.
Congenital intestinal atresia; hemorrhagic anemia in 80-99%; cardiac and aortic malformations reported in 30-79%.
Psychotic disorder; associated cognitive symptoms do not establish a separate neurologic disease. Structural brain abnormalities occur in <30%.
Reported aminoaciduria syndrome with characteristic ataxia and intellectual disability. Short stature and photosensitivity alone do not establish skeletal or skin damage.
Malignant tumor originating in the olfactory cranial nerve.
Benign muscle tumor with skeletal and cardiac sites of origin explicitly included in the definition.
Usher syndrome combines hearing impairment and retinal degeneration; both documented in 2/2 patients.
VZV reactivation directly causes sensory ganglionitis/neuritis and dermatomal vesicular skin lesions. Ocular and otologic disease are minority presentations.
Inherited lipid metabolism disorder; hypertriglyceridemia and other lipid abnormalities in 2/2. No direct extra-metabolic organ damage established.
Sinoatrial node dysfunction causes cardiac rhythm abnormalities; syncope and dizziness do not establish neurologic damage.
Cutaneous glomus tumor arising in dermal perivascular glomus cells; dilated intratumoral veins do not establish additional cardiovascular disease.
Progressive neurodegenerative gait disorder. Reported hypertension is a separate condition; rigidity and gait disability arise neurologically.
Neurodevelopmental and skeletal syndrome with immunodeficiency: low IgG in 2/4 and recurrent infections. Leukopenia/lymphopenia and splenomegaly in 3/4 support blood involvement.
Skeletal dysplasia; subglottic stenosis in 2/3 and mitral regurgitation in 1/3 meet the involvement threshold. Skin thickening frequency is unspecified.
Inherited flattening of the umbilical skin contour; no visceral or other organ involvement established.
Iron-deficient erythropoiesis causes anemia. Gastrointestinal malabsorption or bleeding may cause it but does not establish gastrointestinal involvement by the anemia.
MYSM1-associated marrow failure with anemia, leukopenia and hypogammaglobulinemic immunodeficiency. Other organ abnormalities lack evidence of common direct damage.
Childhood autoinflammatory interferonopathy umbrella; specific neurologic, skin, vascular and pulmonary injuries vary across subtypes.
Glycosylation disorder with steatosis in 5/5 and hepatic fibrosis in 5/7. Elevated CK alone does not establish muscle damage.
Inherited syndrome defined by papillary thyroid carcinoma and renal papillary neoplasia. Unspecified neck vessel morphology does not establish cardiovascular damage.
MHC class II immunodeficiency with reduced immunoglobulins. Pneumonia is a separately diagnosed infection; febrile seizure does not establish neurologic injury.
Congenital cerebral cortical malformation with developmental impairment, hemiparesis and epilepsy; manifestations remain within the neurologic axis.
Cardiac pump failure; pulmonary congestion, edema and congestive hepatomegaly alone do not establish direct lasting injury to additional organs.
Severe Zellweger disease: brain malformation/dysfunction and liver dysfunction are usual (>80%); renal cysts in 1/1 reported. Epiphyseal stippling omitted at four-axis cap.
